We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts. The case: Zhang Moujia (张某甲) contracted wall projects for a real estate developer, and after completion gave kickbacks (回扣) to two officials: Liu Moujia (刘某甲) and Huang Moujia (黄某甲), who are project comprehensive department deputy general manager and project engineering (supervision) department deputy manager. The amount total 94,192 yuan. This is bribery: giving money to state employees? Are they state employees? They are employees of the real estate developer (福鼎碧桂园房地产开发有限公司). That is a private company, not a state organ. So the officials are not state employees. The charge is 行贿 (bribery) or 非国家工作人员受贿? The list includes both 受贿 (receiving bribe) and 行贿 (offering bribe). The facts: Zhang gave kickbacks to Liu and Huang. So Zhang is the briber. The appropriate charge is 行贿. The list also includes 非国家工作人员受贿 (non-state staff receiving bribe). But the defendant is the briber, not the recipient. So we label 行贿.

Check if any other charges: maybe also 经济犯? The list includes 经济犯 (economic crime). But typical classification: bribery is a corruption crime. The examples earlier: For bribery they used 行贿 (for offering bribe) and 受贿 (for receiving). Example: earlier case with 黄某某 gave bribe to 于某甲, they labeled 行贿. So we follow that.

Thus answer: [罪名]行贿<eoa>
